description: Given two non-empty lists of integers a and b, return true if they have at least one element in common (some element of a is equal to some element of b), and false otherwise.
notes: VERINA's postcondition (exists i, j with a[i] == b[j]) <-> result is stated in Dafny as |multiset(a) * multiset(b)| > 0, which is equivalent; Dafny cannot find the witness indices of an existential postcondition on concrete inputs, so the literal form fails the acceptance probes. The Python spec keeps VERINA's form.
